LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.Note: Only active in commitment mode saves.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.IncidentsThreatBigT: Save when an incident of the ThreatBig category fires: raids, sieges, mech clusters, ambushes and everything else the storyteller files under ThreatBig - vanilla, DLC and modded alike.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.IncidentsThreatSmal: Save when an incident of the ThreatSmall category fires: mad animals, blight, toxic fallout and everything else filed under ThreatSmall - vanilla, DLC and modded alike.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.IncidentsInfestatio: Save when a deep drill infestation hatches under your miners.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.IncidentsDiseaseTip: Save when a disease outbreak runs through your pawns.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.PawnDownedTip: Save when a pawn the colony cares about is downed: colonists, prisoners, slaves, guests, quest pawns and colony animals. Enemies and wild animals are ignored.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.PawnKilledTip: Save when a pawn the colony cares about dies - colonists, prisoners, slaves, guests, quest pawns and colony animals. Enemies and wild animals are ignored.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.PrisonBreakTip: Save when prisoners start a prison break.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.MentalBreakMinorTip: Save when a colonist suffers a minor mental break, like tantrums or insults.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.MentalBreakMajorTip: Save when a colonist suffers a major mental break, like binging or sadistic rage.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.MentalBreakExtremeT: Save when a colonist suffers an extreme mental break, like berserk or catatonic.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.BuildingDestroyedTi: Save when a building owned by the colony is destroyed by damage, fire or collapse. Deconstructing it yourself does not count.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.FireStartedTip: Save when a fire appears on one of your maps. As fires spread by creating new fires, saves triggered by this option are limited to one per minute.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.SaveOnExitTip: Write the commitment save when the game process is closed directly, for example with ALT+F4 or by killing the window. Closing the game can no longer roll back to an older state.
LanguageData.ForcedCommitmentMode.DebugLoggingTip: Log every trigger evaluation and save to the game log. For verifying behavior and bug reports.
